3. The facts, in short, which are necessary for disposal of the Rule as indicated above, are as follows :-petitioner No. I as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 8 of 1963 on 16th April, 1963 in the Court of 3rd Subordinate Judge, Dacca which having teen transferred to the Court of the Subordinate Judge, 5th Court, Dacca, was re-numbered as Title Suit No. 162 of 1968. The suit was for declaration that the plaintiffs are the owners of 1/4th share of .40 acre of land in respect of C.S. plot No. 59 under khatian No. 6947, Touzi No. 141 BI, P. S. Ramna, Segunbagicha, Topkhana Road, Dacca, and the proforma defendants are the owners of 3/4th share according to Mohammedan law of inheritance; and that an mutation be made to the Deputy Commissioner, Dacca regarding the filing of the suit as desired by him ordering him to withdraw the payment made to the defendant No. 2 and to withhold the payment yet to be made in respect of .20 acre of land of C. S. plot No. 59 is concerned in L. A. Case No. II of 1961-62 during the pendency of the suit. Proforma deferants were transposed to the category of plaintiff as plaintiff Nos. 2 to 6 on 27th June, 1963 subject to the question of limitation to be decided at the time of trial. Subsequently, the plaintiffs failed an application for amendment of the plant stating inter alia that the plaintiffs land measuring .76 acre is comprised of .36 acre out of plot No. 77 and .31 acre out of plot No. 59 and .09 acre out of plot No. 58 and the suit land measuring .20 acre is out of 31 acre of plot No. 59 but through mistake it was stated in the plaint that the plaintiff's .76 acre land is comprised of .36 acre of plot No. 77 and .40 acre of plot No. 59 and the suit land measuring .20 acre is out of .40 acre of plot No. 59. After hearing both the parties prayer for amendment was allowed by the order No. 27 dated 10th February, 1964. 'Thereafter, the plaintiffs filed another application for amendment of the prayer made in the plaint on 18th November, 1964 in the following manner:- 

 7A. In the counter-affidavit filed by the opposite party (Defendant No. 2) it has been stated inter alia that the petitioner had never any title or possession in .20 acre of schedule 'B' land and the revisional khatian is wrong to that extent. Plot No. 58 has been correctly recorded in the name of this opposite party according to her title document dated 12. 8.49 and actual physical possession and the allegation of undue influence by her husband is false.
